subject: general
question: Chandrayaan I was launched using:
solution:
The correct answer is **__PSLV-C11.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chandrayaan -1,** India's first mission to the Moon was launched using PSLV-C11 from** Sriharikota, Andhra Pradesh.**
 
• It was the first Indian lunar probe launched by ISRO in 2008.
 
• The mission included only a lunar orbiter and no lander or rover.
 
• Was announced by former PM Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee on 15th August 2003.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **ISRO facts:-**

 
 
• Established on 15th august 1969 as INCOSPAR with the efforts of Vikram Sarabhai.
 
• The headquarters is in Bengaluru.
 
• S. Somnath is the current chairman of ISRO.
 
• Aryabhata was the first satellite to be launched in 1975.
 
• Launched Mars Orbiter Mission on 5th November 2013 making
 
• India is the first country ever to succeed in its maiden attempt at Mars.
 
• On 15th February 2017, ISRO made a world record by launching 104 satellites in a single rocket **(PSLV-C37).**
